source_label: SYNTHETIC DEMO AUTHORISATION POLICY — not a legal determination

give_consent_for_other.reason: One adult cannot consent on behalf of another adult in this demo policy.

notes: The absent household head does not automatically block a member's own service request, and does not automatically authorise household-wide changes.
Where authority cannot be established the application pauses and refers the household to an authorised office.
No legal consent rule is asserted; jurisdiction-specific policy is configurable and marked unverified.
